title: Remaining Systems Coverage in Cash Settlements, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Clause.** A systems-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a remaining-coverage multiplier, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled systems settlement. The remaining-coverage multiplier counts the calendar days from the settlement date to the systems end date of the coverage, the settlement date itself not counted: 730 days or more take 1.20; 365 to 729 days take 1.10; fewer than 365 days take 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Calendar days from the settlement date to the systems end date | Remaining-coverage multiplier |
|---|---|
| 730 or more | 1.20 |
| 365 to 729 | 1.10 |
| fewer than 365 | 1.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical systems end date 14 March 2027)

| Settlement date | Days counted | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2025 | 730 | 1.20 |
| 15 March 2025 | 729 | 1.10 |
| 14 March 2026 | 365 | 1.10 |
| 15 March 2026 | 364 | 1.00 |

The systems end date is the one on the coverage record; a subsequent owner's coverage carries the home's original systems end date.
